summary: Tested the Servis / Shërbimi module end to end (backend and UI) and its integration with Qarkullimet Ditore. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass (tests/test_services.py). Covered: employee gets 403; create with number S-xxxx (incrementing) and received_date defaulting to today in Europe/Belgrade; validation returns 422/400; filters q (first name, last name, phone, device), status and date_from/date_to; edit is recorded in history; status PATCH; delivering without paid_amount returns 400; leaving 'delivered' clears the payment fields; re-delivering does not create duplicates; soft delete hides the service from the list, from GET (404) and from the daybook; receipt PDF works, including '<' and '&' in the text. Daybook: services_received is listed on the intake day; the intake price is not counted as income; service_income/profit/delivered/cash count only delivered and paid services; net_profit increases by paid minus parts cost; closing cash rises by the cash amount only; a bank payment goes to bank_in only; sales_total and revenue are unchanged; the report has service_income. UI: everything requested works (see context_for_next_testing_agent).

minor.issue: A service delivered with paid_amount=0 is skipped completely, so the parts_cost of free or warranty repairs is never subtracted from profit. Confirm whether this is intended.
The service entry's 'time' is set to delivered_date (a date only), so service rows sort before same-day entries that have timestamps. Storing a delivered_at timestamp would fix this.

issues: Change keys are shown as raw field names (notes, price, parts_cost, paguar) instead of Albanian labels.

action_items: Optional: decide whether free deliveries (paid 0) with parts_cost should record a loss in the daybook.
Optional: show Albanian labels for the field names in the history dialog.
Note: test_daybook.py TestRealData has 3 failing tests. They hardcode start_date 2026-10-20 / opening 1000, but the user's real setting is 2026-10-21 / 0. These are stale assertions, not app bugs.
critical_code_review_comments: IMPORTANT: the tests/test_daybook.py fixture used to restore the hardcoded REAL_SETTINGS (2026-10-20/1000) at teardown. Running it overwrote the user's real cash settings (2026-10-21/0). I restored the user's values through the API and changed the fixture to restore the original values instead.
services.py PUT does not block editing the received_date of a delivered service (acceptable).
Service entries cannot be corrected through /daybook/override (by design: the UI has no edit button).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST* services (S-0001..S-0014 range used). All were soft-deleted, and none remain active (GET /api/services?q=TEST returns 0). No sales or purchases were created. Daybook settings were restored to 2026-10-21/0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_services.py -n 0. Today in the env is 2026-10-26. The real cash settings are start 2026-10-21, opening 0; do not change them permanently. UI checks that passed: sale-goto-services-btn navigates to /services; nav-services shows for admin; the form defaults to today's date; an empty save is blocked; the print confirm appears after create; the deliver dialog is prefilled with the price; paid cell shows the amount and method; edit prefill; history; status, search and date filters; clear filters; print opens a new tab; delete with confirm. Daily-flow: box counts, cash-service, profit-service, a 'Servis' flow row with no buttons, and daybook-open-services. Employee: no nav link and no sale button; /services redirects to /dashboard.
